items.title: ICMR-STS Research — AI-Assisted Peripheral Blood Smear Screening
items.summary: Conducted an ICMR-STS research project on AI-assisted peripheral blood smear screening and approaches to empowering rural healthcare, under guidance.
items.description: Research work undertaken under guidance in the ICMR Short Term Studentship (ICMR-STS) stream during MBBS. The project explores AI-assisted screening of peripheral blood smears — using computational assistance to support microscopy-based diagnosis — and connects it to approaches for empowering rural healthcare, where specialist pathology access is limited. Work spans literature review, understanding smear morphology, following the study protocol and documenting findings under faculty guidance.

items.title: Winner — AIDS Awareness Poster-Making Competition
items.summary: Won the AIDS awareness poster-making competition — creative health-communication work on HIV/AIDS awareness.
items.description: First place in an AIDS awareness poster-making competition held during MBBS. The entry combined scientific accuracy about HIV transmission, prevention and stigma with visual communication designed to make the message stick — an early example of the healthcare communication focus she continues to pursue.

items.title: 2nd Place — Tuberculosis Awareness Poster-Making Competition
items.summary: Secured 2nd place in a tuberculosis awareness poster-making competition — health-communication work on TB awareness.
items.description: Second place in a tuberculosis awareness poster-making competition during MBBS. The poster addressed TB recognition, treatment completion and community awareness — aligned with national TB-elimination messaging.
